verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly markets per-card spend limits and granular permissions ('Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions'), backed by virtual card creation, card lifecycle/limit management via API, and independent community confirmation of creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits. missing for 10: no hands-on walkthrough of setting a specific per-employee limit in the UI, and no detail on the granularity of permission types available to finance leads beyond marketing copy.
